name: portfolio_analysis
description: Analyze a long-only portfolio using adjusted daily Yahoo Finance prices: total and annualized return, volatility, Sharpe ratio, drawdown, asset statistics, and benchmark correlation/beta. Weights are normalized to 100%; this is descriptive analysis, not investment advice.

weights.description: Optional long-only weights in the same order as symbols. They need not sum to 1 or 100.

benchmark.description: Comparison symbol. Use an empty string to omit benchmark statistics.

risk_free_rate_percent.description: Annual risk-free rate as a percentage, used for the Sharpe ratio.
